source.description: Post-check payload for a Bash tool that ran `cargo build --workspace`. Pins bug #2 (0.13.2): the command-derived `build` tagger must fire, and the compile output under `tool_response` must be read by the cargo adapter to stamp `outcome:compile_ok`.
